name: vercel
description: Vercel MCP server — enables AI assistants to manage deployments, search docs, and check domain availability.

env.VERCEL_TOKEN: Required. Personal access token from https://vercel.com/account/tokens
env.VERCEL_TEAM_ID: Optional. Vercel team/org ID to scope operations.

setup:
1. Create a token at https://vercel.com/account/tokens
2. Set VERCEL_TOKEN in your shell environment or .env
3. Optionally set VERCEL_TEAM_ID for team-scoped access
4. Restart your AI assistant to pick up the new MCP server
